```{r preprocessing-setup}
# 载入项目配置与共享工具 / Load project configuration and shared helpers.
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("SEED_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = getwd()), winslash = "/"), "R", "config.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "io.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "preprocess.R"))

required <- c(
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_16S.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_ITS.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_table_filtered.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_table_filtered.txt"),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "plant_tree", "species_all.nwk")
)
assert_files(required, "initial input")
```

```{r preprocessing-metadata}
# 读取权威 metadata / Read the authoritative metadata.
meta_16s <- data.table::fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_16S.txt"), sep = "\t")
meta_its <- data.table::fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_ITS.txt"), sep = "\t")
stopifnot(nrow(meta_16s) == 3652L, nrow(meta_its) == 2310L)
meta_all <- rbind(meta_16s, meta_its, fill = TRUE)
message(sprintf("metadata: %d 16S + %d ITS = %d samples; %d host genera",
                nrow(meta_16s), nrow(meta_its), nrow(meta_all),
                length(unique(meta_all$Genus))))
```

```{r preprocessing-css-merged}
# 合并数据 CSS 标准化 / CSS normalization of the merged ASV tables.
css_jobs <- list(
  `16s` = list(
    input = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_table_filtered.txt"),
    out = file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_16s_asvtab.txt"),
    nf = file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_16s_normFactors.txt")
  ),
  its = list(
    input = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_table_filtered.txt"),
    out = file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_its_asvtab.txt"),
    nf = file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_its_normFactors.txt")
  )
)
for (ds in names(css_jobs)) {
  job <- css_jobs[[ds]]
  checkpoint(c(job$out, job$nf), paste0("css_merged_", ds), {
    css_normalize(job$input, job$out, job$nf)
  })
}
```

```{r preprocessing-css-region}
# 六个区段独立 CSS 标准化 / CSS normalization for six amplicon regions.
for (reg in REGIONS_ALL) {
  reg_upper <- toupper(reg)
  input <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_region", reg_upper,
                     paste0(reg_upper, "_merged_asvtab_filtered.txt"))
  out_dir <- file.path(CSS_DIR, "region", reg)
  out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("css_", reg, "_asvtab.txt"))
  nf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("css_", reg, "_normFactors.txt"))
  checkpoint(c(out, nf), paste0("css_region_", reg), {
    css_normalize(input, out, nf)
  })
}
```

```{r preprocessing-sample-names}
# 恢复 metadata 样本名（连字符转点、数字开头加 X）/ Restore metadata sample naming.
standardize_sample_names(CSS_DIR)
```

```{r preprocessing-taxa}
# 合并数据聚合到五个分类层级 / Aggregate merged CSS tables to five taxonomic levels.
tax_pairs <- list(
  `16s` = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_taxonomy_filtered.txt"),
  its = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_taxonomy_filtered.txt")
)
for (ds in names(tax_pairs)) {
  css_file <- file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", paste0("css_", ds, "_asvtab.txt"))
  out_dir <- file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged")
  checkpoint(file.path(out_dir, paste0(c("phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus"),
                                        "_", ds, "_asvtab.txt")),
             paste0("taxa_", ds), {
    aggregate_taxa_levels(css_file, tax_pairs[[ds]], out_dir, ds)
  })
}
```

```{r preprocessing-host-trees}
# 从 TimeTree5 导出树派生区域树与属级树 / Derive region and genus host trees.
assert_files(file.path(DATA_DIR, "plant_tree", "species_all.nwk"), "TimeTree export")
checkpoint(file.path(TREE_DIR, c("plant_species_tree_all.nwk", "plant_species_tree_v4.nwk",
                                 "plant_species_tree_v5_v7.nwk", "plant_species_tree_its1.nwk",
                                 "plant_Genus_tree_all.nwk")),
           "host_trees", {
  build_host_trees(file.path(DATA_DIR, "plant_tree", "species_all.nwk"),
                   file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_16S.txt"),
                   file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_ITS.txt"),
                   TREE_DIR)
})
```

```{r preprocessing-color-map}
# 构建统一的宿主分类配色 / Build shared host-taxonomy colour maps.
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "diversity.R"))
checkpoint(file.path(DERIVED_DIR, c("color_map.rds", "color_map_flat.rds")),
           "color_maps", {
  cm <- build_color_map(meta_all)
  cm_flat <- build_color_map_flat(meta_all)
  saveRDS(cm, file.path(DERIVED_DIR, "color_map.rds"))
  saveRDS(cm_flat, file.path(DERIVED_DIR, "color_map_flat.rds"))
})
```

```{r preprocessing-check}
# 输出规模自检 / Check key dimensions before downstream chapters.
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_16s_asvtab.txt")))
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_its_asvtab.txt")))
for (reg in REGIONS3) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(CSS_DIR, "region", reg, paste0("css_", reg, "_asvtab.txt"))))
}
message("preprocessing checkpoints ready / 预处理检查点就绪")
```
